source.instrument: Nortek Acoustic Doppler Wave and Current Profiler (AWAC)

normalization.method: parse each native profile; robust median east/north vector across cells >=2 after excluding speed >2 m/s when >=5 cells remain; hourly vector means
normalization.unit_evidence: Nortek published current-profile ASCII documentation identifies cell position in m, Velocity East/North/Up and Speed in m/s, and Direction in degrees; the delivered row structure and speed/direction are numerically consistent with that layout.
normalization.time_semantics: source clock preserved; timezone not inferred from delivered archive

observed_vector_displacement_windows.note: integrated hourly robust vectors; displacement is observed-current context at the AWAC station, not Point Clear shore-normal transport

interpretation: Observed currents can advect water over kilometer scales within 3-12 hours and multi-kilometer scales over 1-2 days. This supports testing transport as a separate trigger state, but this offshore/southwest record does not by itself validate Point Clear NGOFS2 direction, phase, magnitude, or shoreline delivery.
remaining_validation_gate: Match active Mobile Bay PORTS observed currents or a temporally overlapping historical observed-current station to NGOFS2 station output with verified station/depth/time semantics, then score vector direction, phase and magnitude.
